observations.label: Booking
observations.caption: The customer chooses a service.
observations.evidence: Selected service gains a teal background and the booking summary updates.

observations.label: Booking
observations.caption: The customer selects an available appointment time.
observations.evidence: Loaded grid is visible from the start. 09:00 becomes green. The cut ends before the customer form.

observations.label: Confirmed
observations.caption: Tori displays an in-app booking confirmation.
observations.evidence: Same fixture as the owner calendar. Uses the real on-screen confirmation and omits contact form and notification delivery.

observations.label: Confirmed
observations.caption: Tori displays the appointment detail page.
observations.evidence: Settled manage page repeats the mobile/desktop confirmation story. Preserved as a reviewed alternative.

observations.label: Calendar
observations.caption: The same appointment appears in the business calendar.
observations.evidence: The day count changes from zero to one and the confirmed 09:00 row appears. Startup view is excluded.

observations.label: Availability
observations.caption: The owner changes Sunday’s closing time to noon.
observations.evidence: The displayed 18:00 setting becomes 12:00. The affected interval bar stays visible.

observations.label: Availability
observations.caption: Tori confirms that the business hours were saved.
observations.evidence: The genuine save toast validates the change. The 12:00 field is off screen, so this is an alternate.

observations.label: Availability
observations.caption: The revised hours leave only morning times available.
observations.evidence: Eligible morning slots and 09:00–12:00 are stable after the request finishes. Independent owner-hours fixture.

observations.label: Also on mobile
observations.caption: A separate mobile session shows appointment selection.
observations.evidence: Independent fixture shows the responsive grid and a green selection before contact details open.
